Jo: dropping a slimline final draft. Need quick passes on: hero claim, single benchmark sentence, webinar CTA, and UTMs. Link: https://docs.google.com/draft/redwood-slim (comments open).

Riley: quick read now. The hero says 'industry-leading' 9 change to 'production-grade' to avoid hype.

Jo: done.

Chen: benchmark suggestion: 'Median token latency improved ~33% in our 8k-sequence microbench (quantized 4-bit); production results may vary.' short + footnote.

Sofia: CTA option: 'Join our Optimize webinar 9 regional sessions' or 'Save your seat 9 Live demo + Q&A'. lean the regional phrasing for top-funnel.

legal-bot: Reminder: avoid absolutes like 'best' or 'fastest'. Add methodology footnote and partner consent for quotes. I added standard copy in the doc.

ops-bot: UTMs: blog: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=content, utm_campaign=optimize_launch; webinar: utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=registration, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_demo; add hs_form_guid and session_region hidden fields.

design: Need hero by EOD for publish slot. Prefer 1200x630.

Jo: thanks all 9 I'll lock the CTA to 'regional sessions' and wire the UTMs + footnote. Will queue publish if no objections in 2hrs.
note: Short Slack thread capturing rapid passes for blog publish: hero, benchmark line, CTA, UTMs, with bots and design note. Chronological order preserved.
